title: In Postgres Enterprise Manager (PEM), the pem.deploy_job_template() function does not check that the caller can access…
description: In Postgres Enterprise Manager (PEM) versions prior to 10.6.1, the function pem.deploy_job_template() does not verify that the caller has access rights to the servers, groups, and agents targeted for job template deployment. This allows a user with the scheduled tasks role (pem_manage_schedule_task) to deploy and schedule SQL or shell job steps on agents belonging to other teams, bypassing intended access controls. Starting with PEM 10.6.1, access checks are enforced for every server, group, and agent involved in deployment.
